verdict.line: You lose if you let her chain Test of Spirit and Harsh Lesson near a tentacle wall; you claw it back only by surviving to 6 and forcing fights with Realm of Death.

brief.thesis: Illaoi's power lives in her passive Tentacles, which spawn on nearby walls and swing at anyone tethered by E (Test of Spirit) or turned into a Vessel — that terrain-based zone control, not her raw stats, is why she holds a 40.5% win rate over 37 games against you. Your one hard counter to that system is R (Realm of Death): it physically removes her from the map the tentacles live on, so the only fights worth taking are ones you start.

theirWindow.when: She lands E near a tentacle wall
theirWindow.what: Do not stand and trade — the spirit echoes a percentage of damage back onto you and nearby tentacles swing for free, so disengage or kill the spirit immediately rather than contest it.

yourWindow.when: Level 6+, away from walls, E on her cooldown
yourWindow.what: Initiate with E (Death's Grasp) to pull her off the wave, then R (Realm of Death) to drag her into the Realm — her tentacles cannot follow, so the fight becomes a clean stat-steal duel you can actually win.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: The extra HP pool and two potions are what let you actually absorb Harsh Lesson and spirit-echo chip damage long enough to reach level 6 without being zoned off farm.

boots.why: Tentacles and her autos are physical damage, and OP.GG's own read on this matchup is to stack armor — Steelcaps directly blunts both the wall tentacles and her auto-reliant trades.

core.why: The slow on Q and E lets you actually close distance or disengage from her E tether range instead of eating a free spirit rip.
Omnivamp turns your R-forced duels into sustained fights you can win once her tentacles are out of the picture.
Her kit has no hard CC to punish burn damage, so the DOT keeps ticking through her passive tankiness in extended Realm of Death fights.

situational.when: she builds into attack speed or lifesteal to abuse her auto-reliant tentacle procs
the lane turns into a sustain war and you need the heal amp to out-trade her tentacle lifesteal
you're ahead and want to force all-ins faster off cooldown-reduced E and R

runes.keystoneWhy: Conqueror's stacking adaptive damage and healing is what keeps you alive through the spirit-echo chip damage during a forced Realm of Death duel, converting a long fight into sustained value instead of a burst loss.

summoners.why: Flash is mandatory to dodge E (Test of Spirit) range or reposition out of a tentacle wall; Ignite punishes the all-ins Illaoi is favored to start, since you can't out-sustain her passive tentacle healing without burning her HP down directly.

playing.title: Never fight tethered to a wall
playing.detail: Tentacles only spawn on nearby impassible terrain, so pulling fights into open lane removes her entire passive damage and healing source.

playing.title: Break or flee the spirit instantly
playing.detail: The moment E lands, either kill the spirit before it echoes real damage or walk away — standing in it while trading is how you lose HP for free.

playing.title: Stack passive on minions before dueling
playing.detail: Land Q (Obliterate) into the wave to build Darkness Rise stacks (3 hits) before she closes, so you enter the trade with the damage aura and move speed already active.

playing.title: Bank your shield, don't waste it
playing.detail: Hold W (Indestructible) uncast until you're about to take a real trade or Harsh Lesson leap, then pop it to convert stored damage into a heal mid-fight.

playing.title: Avoid isolated trades before level 6
playing.detail: Her solo-kill advantage is real pre-6 — play for CS and wave state rather than contesting any extended 1v1.

playing.title: Use R to remove her, not just to steal stats
playing.detail: The primary value of Realm of Death here is dragging her off her tentacle network entirely, turning an unfair zone fight into a fair duel.

playing.title: Itemize armor on first back
playing.detail: Rush Plated Steelcaps and lean into armor-scaling choices early since both her tentacles and autos are physical damage.

brief.patchCaveat: Win rates, build paths, runes, and summoner picks above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the tactical reasoning connecting them to ability mechanics is my own analysis, not sourced data.

stats.opponentTip: Purchase Plated Steelcaps, Bramble Vest, and other items that increase armor. Avoid being hit with Illaoi’s (E) whiel focusing on farming and fighting her.
